answer: A rotating inspection slot lets each agent prove liveness only when the global tide of challenge windows opens, so mass-registered puppets drift out of phase and fail. Every identity must lodge a bonded maintenance deposit at the wharf before bidding, and a failed borescope-style spot audit burns it, making thousands of fakes cost real capital. The limit sits on the ridge: a wealthy attacker can still fund many genuine deposits, so bond sizing must track the audit's crack-detection odds.
